text:
Anya: heads-up — us-west1 GPU pool at 92% util, queue length has doubled in the last 8m. seeing latency spikes for standard tier requests.
Mike: saw the alert, confirmed. standard QPS is steady but p99 token latency creeping up. any quick wins?
SRE Bot: alert: region=us-west1 metric=gpu_utilization threshold=90 percent=92.1 window=5m
Sanjay: can we spillover to us-west2 and europe-west1? networking egress costs will go up but better than SLO violations.
Katie: two constraints: (1) some customers pinned to us-west1 for data locality, (2) model variants differ per region — not all regions have the 8-bit quantized variant.
Anya: proposal: implement temporary tiered admission + routing order: 1) local dedicated pool, 2) cross-region spillover (same tier), 3) fallback to smaller model variant in-region, 4) best-effort cross-region smaller variant. also apply soft drop to single-request heavy token loads.
Mike: +1. need to limit cross-region spillover to avoid global ripple. suggest per-minute spillover budget and per-customer opt-out honoring data residency.
Sanjay: adding a short config snippet i tested locally:
```yaml
admission_control:
  queue_limit: 300
  soft_drop_threshold_ms: 1500
  spillover:
    enabled: true
    budget_per_minute: 200
    order: [local_pool, cross_region_same_tier, local_fallback_model, cross_region_fallback]
    exclude_tags: [pinned_data_locality]
```
Katie: how do we detect when to trigger fallback model vs cross-region? we should prioritize latency SLOs, not just capacity.
Anya: rule: if estimated added tail latency from cross-region hop > fallback_model_latency_penalty then fallback in-region first. fallback_model_latency_penalty is measured from evals (typical +30-80ms).
Luis: need metrics: current per-region queue length, avg time-in-queue, per-model kv cache hit rates. i can add a dashboard.
Mike: also consider preemptible ephemeral nodes: spin-up cheaper nodes to absorb burst but pin premium traffic to reserved GPUs. saves cost vs cross-region egress.
SRE Bot: deploy-bot: new admission-config v0.3 staged to canary in us-west1 at 1773001300
Anya: canary started, watch queue length and p99 for standard and premium.
Sanjay: quick command to check queues: curl -s http://ops.internal/queues?region=us-west1 | jq .summary
Mike: logs from canary show spillover events but respecting budget so far:
```
[1773001321] spillover: routed 34 requests to us-west2, budget_remaining=166
[1773001338] fallback: routed 12 requests to model-compact-1 in us-west1
```
Katie: next steps: (1) add data residency tag enforcement to routing, (2) add metric for cross-region egress cost estimate, (3) run 30m canary and then auto-scale spillover budget if stable.
Luis: i'll build the dashboard and add cost estimate metric.
Mike: ops action: prepare playbook for roll-back and manual cutoff if cross-region starts to exceed X dollars/hour.
Anya: thanks all — will update runbook and open a follow-up thread with canary results. :thumbsup:
SRE Bot: note: thread auto-archived after 24h if no activity
